name: Adachi Ryou
source:
Favorite Color: Blue/Black
Special Skills: Cooking/Housework/Making Candy
Hobby: Writing
Feelings Toward the Protagonist: Childhood Friend/If I'm not with her it's no good

3rd year university student.
His father owns a large confectionery company and despite his own wishes he is supposed to inherit it.
He's in charge of his parents vacation house and rents rooms out to his friends.
